Comic David Lucas talks with Danny Jones about Joe Rogan, politics, and conspiracy theories in this episode. Lucas is a stand-up known for roasting crowds and for his ties to the Austin comedy scene that Rogan built. The talk mixes laughs with rabbit holes, in his style.

Lucas shares stories from the road and from Rogan's club, where comics test their sharpest material. He gives his take on the political turn of comedy and on which conspiracies he half believes. Jones, a fan of both worlds, keeps him riffing. Listeners get a comic's view of strange times, funny first and serious second.
